review.posthog_relevance: Changes the metrics catalog loading strategy in PostHog's frontend, switching from a bulk fetch of metric details to a bulk fetch of metric names with lazy-loaded details. This could improve performance and reduce unnecessary API calls for users viewing metrics dashboards.
review.reason: Adds a new API call, metricsNamesRetrieve, alongside the existing metricsValuesRetrieve. P1.F4.H4 replaces the bulk catalog fetch with this new call, while P1.F4.H5 retains the original call for lazy sparkline loading. P1.F4.H3 and P1.F4.H4 also add new state and actions for the sparkline loading lifecycle.

observations.posthog_connection: Changes the catalog loading strategy from a bulk fetch of metric details to a bulk fetch of metric names, with details loaded lazily. P1.F4.H4: "It returns only names; visible cards load their own sparkline later instead of one query sampling every metric." P1.F4.H5: "Keep one request per name and retry only after a failed request or after the catalog scope changes."

observations.posthog_connection: Stores cached metric details and loading status per name, enabling the lazy-loading and deduplication of sparkline requests. P1.F4.H3: "Details depend on the service scope. Drop the old scope as soon as a replacement name list starts loading, so a late card can never show a sparkline from the service the person just left."
